title: Strictness of a strictified gate
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and let $g$ be a gate with at most two inputs, no repeated input vertices, and exactly one input if it is a NOT gate. The gate obtained by strictifying $g$ has no repeated input vertices and has exactly one input if it is a NOT gate, and exactly two inputs otherwise.
hypotheses_covered: if $g$ is a NOT gate, it has exactly one input
